auth.ticket: signed by the AUTH account's scoped key, pre-signed before each run
auth.callout: role-name mapper, user JWT valid 1 hour

variants.label: main_mutex
variants.conf:
# nats-server settings for a profiled run (`bench run --profile --variants profile-variants.toml`): the pprof endpoint, and the block profile
# at rate 1 (every blocking event is recorded). Block profiling slows the broker, so a profiled run's timings are not comparable with runs
# without it; what it is for is where the waiting is. nats-server never sets the mutex profile, so on an unpatched broker only the block
# profile has data; a broker built with `--patch mutex-profile` also fills /debug/pprof/mutex (who held the lock).
prof_port: 6060
prof_block_rate: 1

profiling.taken_by: the CPU probes, every few seconds
profiling.note: block profiling slows the broker: the timings of this run are perturbed and not comparable with runs without it
